cat > repro_test.py << 'EOF'
import ops
from ops import testing

class MyCharm(ops.CharmBase):
    pass

META = {
    "name": "my-charm",
    "requires": {
        "db": {"interface": "pgsql"},
        "not-integrated": {"interface": "whatever"},
    },
}

def test_get_relation_wrong_name_same_id():
    ctx = testing.Context(MyCharm, meta=META)
    rel = testing.Relation("db", id=1)
    state_in = testing.State(relations={rel}, leader=True)
    with ctx(ctx.on.update_status(), state_in) as manager:
        charm = manager.charm
        relation = charm.model.get_relation("not-integrated", 1)
        print(relation.data[charm.app])
EOF
expected: get_relation('not-integrated', 1) should raise an error, since relation id 1 belongs to the 'db' endpoint, not 'not-integrated' (which has no active relations).
observed: Per the reporter: relation object creation is not blocked, and accessing relation.data[app] silently returns the databag belonging to relation id 1 (i.e. the 'db' relation's data), instead of raising.
